id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1755: "Be very careful of monsters with green eyes. They're many times stronger than before!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|179a: "I hear lots of soldiers are gathering at the castle. The mood is so different. Is some event starting?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17ac: "Oh, Luminary. Are you headed somewhere? You never get a moment to breathe.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17b6: "If that's the Luminary's mission, I could never manage it...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1843: "Before the great tree fell, I used to chat with my sweetheart on a sunny bench.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1850: "Now all those days seem like a dream...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|185c: "Hiding timidly is no use now. If monsters get into the bastion, we won't stand a chance...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|186b: "The monsters have retreated for now, right... Thank goodness... I was so scared...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1878: "It's a victory night, yet it looks like rain, and my spirits are dark too...

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1894: "Will the day come when I can laugh like before...

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18ab: "The King of Heliodor is waiting for you. Hurry to his tent.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a63: "The two going out together is rare. Where on earth had they gone...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a71: "The Luminary has been given a mission by the king. Go through the castle gate to the Emerald Coast.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ba1: "Hey, your boyfriend's me, you know. Tch, I'm fed up!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bac: "Bah! Some hero! He's just a bit taller, stronger, and better-looking than me!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bc0: "I can out-talk anyone, but I've never had a real fight. Fighting monsters is no joke.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bcf: "Roxy darling! I hurt my arm too! Treat me, please!

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bee: "Heh heh. I believed in you, so I never considered abandoning the Last Bastion for even a second!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bff: "The stars twinkle so prettily. It'd be perfect to watch a night sky like this with a girl.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c0c: "I'm a man who lives for love. For Princess Jade, I'll haul cargo or anything!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c18: "From the moment I first saw Princess Jade, I've been love's captive! I love her sharp eyes!

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c34: "I even locked eyes with the King of Heliodor for a moment. I'm lucky today! Ah, I should've asked for a handshake...!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c47: "The blue-haired man standing in front of the dining hall... I feel I've seen him somewhere. Where was it...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c53: "Damn... At times like this, if Noah the informant were here, he'd know anyone's past instantly.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dda: "It's lively outside today. What could have happened in peaceful Heliodor...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e29: "Some scoundrel who once broke into the castle treasury tried to escape the dungeon. Our pay took a big hit...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e3a: "Damn that young punk! If only I clearly remembered his face, I'd chase him to hell and catch him!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e49: "Oh... Luminary {var:1}. News of the Luminary's star falling has spread unease through the town.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e57: "Please, {var:1}. Hurry to the Emerald Coast and see how the Luminary's star looks.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e9a: "Someday I'll be strong and kind like General Hendrik, respected by soldiers!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ea8: "Everyone at the castle is eating yummy food, right? Aw, I want to go too.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2135: "I heard a terrible rumor. They say the King of Heliodor was possessed by a monster...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2140: "Oh no, mister. Eavesdropping on people is rude. Go away.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2150: "Hiding just because I'm a woman doesn't suit me. Carrying weapons is nothing!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|215d: "Understand? Out of the way! You're in my way!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2165: "Busy, busy! Piles of wounded keep coming, I've no time to rest!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|217a: "It's been ages since Jasper left the castle. Where is he? I hope he isn't hurt somewhere.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2184: "The king and General Hendrik returned, but say nothing about Jasper... It feels odd.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2203: "Usually I can relax in this plaza, but I have a bad feeling today.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|220c: "What could happen in this peaceful Kingdom of Heliodor, I wonder.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|221e: "General Hendrik has joined the Luminary. Former enemies become reliable allies once they share a goal.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|222f: "With the general and the Luminary joining forces, they're unbeatable. I pray for a safe journey.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23f4: "I worked hard with my wife, believing the day I'd see you again would come! I'm so happy to see you!

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2884: "My, as a noblewoman I don't gossip. Ahem... Ohohoho.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2890: "It's fine. With the hero here, monsters are a snap!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|289d: "The monsters withdrew for now. My life got a little longer. How thankful.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28b2: "Oh, headed to Heliodor Castle? I don't know the details, but the king is receiving an important guest.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28c2: "I won't stop you if you want to meet the king, but he probably won't see you at the castle now...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28d0: "They say the King of Heliodor is hosting a grand banquet for an important guest. How lavish.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28e0: "They say the King of Heliodor is hosting a grand banquet for an important guest. How lavish.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28f2: "I've lived in this town for decades, but I've never felt Heliodor this tense.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2912: "I've lived in this town for decades, but I've never felt Heliodor this tense.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2901: "After all, a star fell. Even my grandmother's generation never heard of such a thing...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2920: "After all, a star fell. Even my grandmother's generation never heard of such a thing...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2959: "I overheard the soldiers say Princess Jade, thought dead, has been found.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2966: "I don't know how she lived, but a young princess missing sixteen years must have suffered much...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2977: "The soldiers are restless. Don't disturb an old man's quiet, relaxed moment.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2985: "The soldiers are restless. Don't disturb an old man's quiet, relaxed moment.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29d6: "Since returning to the castle, the king has awaited the Luminary's arrival. Please go in.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a03: "They say you're taking General Hendrik and Princess Jade on your journey. In his heart, the king must want them near.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a12: "But as king, he can't easily tell them how he feels...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a77: "Hmm, trouble, trouble... We have nowhere near enough food. At this rate we'll all starve...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a82: "Maybe grass and twigs would be edible if boiled. I'll go gather some...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a92: "What are these things?! We defeat them and defeat them, but they keep springing up from nowhere!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aa5: "And General Hendrik charged into the monsters alone... I hope he's safe...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ab5: "Despite the fierce attack, miraculously no deaths, and only light wounds. Thanks to you fighting with us.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ac8: "Not enough... not at all. Hmm... food...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ad2: "With even a little sunlight, fruit and vegetables will grow, so the bastion's food shortage will soon end.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ae1: "It's all thanks to your and General Hendrik's brave fight. Thank you, truly.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aef: "The King of Heliodor asked that we treat you with courtesy. Please go ahead.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2afd: "Oh... Luminary {var:1}. Did the kingdom's size make you lost? Please return to the castle.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b11: "Princess Jade will keep traveling with the Luminary as before. Isn't the king lonely?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b1e: "The queen died long ago... and in the sixteen years he was controlled by a monster, the princess grew into an adult...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b2e: "If I were the king, I couldn't even cry when I wanted to. His anguish must be immense...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b81: "What time is it, and where am I... With no sunrise, I can't tell morning from night...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b8b: "If this pitch dark continues, I'll forget who I am and end up a night dweller...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ba6: "...What?! You already defeated it? I had my eyes shut, so I didn't know! I'm amazed!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bb6: "Wow, your strength amazed me! You kicked those vicious monsters away like pebbles!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bc1: "I want to get strong like you too! Train me sometime!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bd5: "With the monsters gone I'm happy to go back to Heliodor, but leaving this village is a bit sad.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2be4: "Don't worry about Heliodor! With General Hendrik and Princess Jade, our future is bright. Hahaha!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bf5: "Don't worry about Heliodor! With General Hendrik and Princess Jade, our future is bright. Hahaha!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c07: "Oh... Luminary {var:1}. Please forgive our many rudenesses.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c1e: "Oh... Luminary {var:1}. Please forgive our many rudenesses.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c11: "The King of Heliodor also wishes to apologize. Please come in.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c28: "The king wishes to apologize to you. But it's late, so please come back in the morning.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c37: "Oh, Luminary. Did you forget something in the town? Return to the castle before everyone worries.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c46: "How many times have I seen you here, Luminary? You truly have a bond with this castle.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c6c: "Entering the castle at night is forbidden. If you have business, come in the morning.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c9f: "I've served the Heliodor royal family twenty years. Losing our sun is actually the second time.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cab: "The first was sixteen years ago, when our princess Jade disappeared.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cc0: "Had the princess been by our king's side, she'd surely have noticed the change. What an unfortunate turn...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cd3: "Don't touch my comrades! I'm your opponent! Come at me!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cdf: "You even help us, your former enemies! We'll repay this debt someday!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cf0: "You even help us, your former enemies! We'll repay this debt someday!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d01: "Oh no, no! I wasn't dozing off on guard duty. Don't say that, hahaha.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d10: "My one regret after this battle is that we still don't know where our princess Jade is.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d3b: "My one regret after this battle is that we still don't know where our princess Jade is.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d26: "Princess Jade, it has been long. We Heliodor people sincerely believed you were safe.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d51: "Princess Jade, it has been long. We Heliodor people sincerely believed you were safe.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d66: "General Hendrik and Princess Jade together bring back old memories.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d82: "General Hendrik and Princess Jade together bring back old memories.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d70: "General Hendrik holding the princess crying after the king scolded her looked like adorable siblings.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d8c: "General Hendrik holding the princess crying after the king scolded her looked like adorable siblings.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d9c: "I heard from the King of Heliodor. We were all wrong... Please, come into the castle.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dad: "I've heard it all from the King of Heliodor. The Luminary is no devil's child bringing calamity. We were mistaken...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dbd: "It's night so I can't show you in, but come again in the morning and hear the king out.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dcd: "You look pale. Did you overeat the feast? Maybe take a walk around the town.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ddc: "Luminary... please look after Princess Jade and General Hendrik.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e21: "We've been waiting, Luminary {var:1}. I heard the circumstances from the king. We were terribly rude before...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e2f: "We'll guard strictly so no outlaws slip in during the banquet. Please rest easy.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e41: "The soldiers are carried away by the banquet, but for those on guard duty, no occasion matters.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e4e: "Monsters attack just when everyone lets their guard down.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e5b: "I heard the Luminary's power defeated the evil monster possessing the king. Then what is this evil presence...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e73: "Oh, Luminary {var:1}. Welcome. I heard from the king.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e7c: "I'm keeping watch so useless onlookers don't enter the castle. Please go in while you can!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e8d: "A while ago I was watching the castle and the soldiers seemed to be stirring. What was that...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e9b: "I heard everything about the banquet night. We swear to guard the king even more closely from now on!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ead: "Who're you? Bah! You've no key, have you. Get lost!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ef1: "...Are you {var:1}? Meeting you here is unbelievably lucky.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2efb: "I'm Miranda, Derk's wife. I've heard so much about you and your friends from my husband.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f09: "My husband runs an item shop in the west of the residential area. He's always worried about you, so please show your face.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f1c: "If you need anything for battle, my husband Derk will prepare it. Please talk to him.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f2b: "{var:1}, my husband Derk is safe, as you see. Let me thank you. Thank you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f38: "My husband, though he doesn't look it, is always worried about you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f3f: "Like everyone, my husband and I believe in you. Please take care...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f4e: "Beautiful Heliodor turned into a monster's castle is like a nightmare...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f58: "That town is my hometown. It holds so many favorite places and precious memories...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f69: "My husband Derk can't sleep at night worrying about his old friend Erik.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f84: "My husband Derk can't sleep at night worrying about his old friend Erik.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f74: "If he learns Erik is safe, my husband will perk up, so please come see him anytime.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f8f: "If he learns Erik is safe, my husband will perk up, so please come see him anytime.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fa0: "Now that the world is at peace, my husband Derk is fired up to show his skills as a merchant.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fbd: "Now that the world is at peace, my husband Derk is fired up to show his skills as a merchant.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fac: "When Heliodor is rebuilt, he says he'll open an even bigger shop and let me live in comfort.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fc9: "When Heliodor is rebuilt, he says he'll open an even bigger shop and let me live in comfort.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fda: "Hello. I'm Miranda, Derk's wife. My husband often told me about Erik.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fe3: "Ever since hearing you were invited to the castle by the King of Heliodor, my husband has been thrilled.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ff4: "Good evening, {var:1}. Your childhood friend Gemma is such a sweet, good girl.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ffe: "Leaving such a nice girl in your hometown, you're sly, {var:1}. Take good care of her.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|300c: "Gemma said she had a bad feeling and ran to the throne room. What is this ominous atmosphere...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|301d: "Hehe. My husband is thrilled about you, {var:1}, as if it were himself. Just like a child.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3027: "Do your best, {var:1}. We're praying here that you meet the king without nerves.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3035: "Ugh... Darling, I'm scared. Please don't leave me alone... Stay by me...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3042: "When I heard the Luminary's star fell, I despaired that the world would end.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|304f: "But listening to my husband, I feel things will work out. And we have the Luminary.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3060: "Oh... please help us, Luminary. My husband Derk was carried off by monsters. You're my only hope.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|306c: "He was taken toward Cobblestone Tor in Cobblestone. Please, darling, be safe...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|307c: "My husband's safe?! You saved him?! Ah, thank goodness... Thank you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30ab: "My husband's safe?! You saved him?! Ah, thank goodness... Thank you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3087: "...Knowing he's alive is enough. If alive, wherever he is, he'll come back here someday.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30b6: "...Knowing he's alive is enough. If alive, wherever he is, he'll come back here someday.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3098: "Knowing my husband is alive is enough. If alive, wherever he is, he'll come back here someday.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30d0: "Welcome! Everything here is essential for a journey. Take a look!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30f1: "Welcome! Everything here is essential for a journey. Take a look!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3132: "After Jasper left, General Hendrik took the King of Heliodor and followed him out of the castle.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|313f: "The king and the general returned, but what of Jasper...? No report is strange.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3151: "Ugh... Listen, Luminary. I truly didn't want to destroy Cobblestone...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|315d: "Why did the king give such a cruel order... I don't understand his thinking...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|316e: "Princess Jade told me... that Jasper was used by the monster possessing the king and lost his life...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|317b: "General Hendrik, who grew up with Jasper from childhood, says nothing, but must be hurting more than anyone.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|318d: "What is it, Luminary? The king went to the third floor. He's not here.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|319a: "General Hendrik will go with you. A fierce general of Heliodor at your side is worth a hundred men.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31be: "Luminary, you came. The King of Heliodor awaits in the throne room one floor below.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31dd: "What's wrong, Luminary? Everyone's waiting in the throne room, so hurry.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31ed: "Oh! Luminary. I heard from General Hendrik. Please go ahead.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31f7: "They say the Luminary's star shows an anomaly. Hurry, Luminary!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3205: "You seem to have seen something ominous on the balcony. I felt strong evil from here too.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3232: "Luminary... I heard. It was we who were wrong. We are truly sorry...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|323f: "Even if on the King of Heliodor's orders, I arrested you back then believing you a devil's child.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3257: "It was so noisy I woke up, and everyone's gathered and the dog's barking. What's going on?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3267: "Huff, puff... Luminary, please, go to the balcony quickly...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3271: "Huff... It's better you see than have me explain...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|327f: "The monster possessing the king was defeated by the Luminary. What could happen now...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|328d: "Please, Luminary. To reassure the people, go see how the Luminary's star looks.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|329d: "Welcome back, {var:1}. If you learned anything about the Luminary's star, please report to the king.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32ae: "To be honest, I secretly thought Princess Jade should stop the dangerous journey and return to the castle...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32bc: "But hearing your talk reassured me. From now on we'll see off the princess's journey.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32ef: "General Hendrik and General Jasper, together they were called the twin-headed eagle after Heliodor's crest.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32fc: "They were our idols. Where did the cool General Jasper go...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3319: "Thank you... After a rest I'll fight too. I must protect the bastion and everyone.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3328: "My judgment was right! From the first time I saw you, I knew you had promise!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3337: "Heliodor's hero General Hendrik and our hope the Luminary {var:1}... side by side, a perfect picture.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|334a: "Calling the one who holds the title of Luminary a devil's child was our great mistake...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3359: "The Luminary is truly one with courage. The King of Heliodor said you're a light of hope for the world.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3368: "May the light of hope that is the Luminary shine on the world. We Heliodor soldiers wish you success.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|337a: "Princess Jade... how beautiful. They say she lived in hiding sixteen years, but her innate grace can't be hidden.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3389: "But what will she do from now on? I wish she'd stay in this castle that I guard...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3399: "Oh, Luminary. The dog that was barking at the king's room ran off to the throne room.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33a6: "I hear something like groans from the throne room. Who is in there...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33b5: "I thought the Luminary was a devil's child, but that was a lie, and the man I took for the king was a monster...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33c3: "...My head hurts, but the bad guys are gone now, right? Then I won't worry about the details!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33d4: "The Luminary isn't a devil's child, and the lord I thought was our king was a monster... And now...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33e1: "The sky turned a strange color. I thought peace had come, but it hadn't...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33f2: "Ugh... Princess Jade... Such a beautiful woman, and she's going on a journey. I'm worried...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|33fc: "Please, {var:1}. Protect Princess Jade in our place...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|342d: "I saw with my own eyes black clouds rising from that beautiful Heliodor Castle.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|343b: "It was the most terrifying sight of my life. My legs shake just remembering.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|344c: "Many of the monsters attacking the Last Bastion dwell on the border of this world and the next.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3457: "Once battle starts, they won't understand words, so you must fight with resolve.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3466: "The monsters fled to Heliodor Castle with tails between their legs! We won! Yay!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3474: "Standing on the watchtower, the sun is dazzling! It feels so good!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3481: "Looking at a starry sky... how many days has it been. My heart feels at ease.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|348f: "The king says that despite the cruel treatment you suffered, you saved this country...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|349c: "An apology won't be forgiven, but it seems we had misunderstood you all this time...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34aa: "Come on, sit down! You might only get a chance to sit in the king's chair tonight!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34b9: "To think that Jasper was a lackey of the monster possessing the king... What a shock.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34c4: "From now on the king and Princess Jade will lead the people rightly. We must support them with all our might.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34d7: "I worried about the king, whose body was controlled by a monster for sixteen years, but he seems to have recovered.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34f7: "I worried about the king, whose body was controlled by a monster for sixteen years, but he seems to have recovered.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|34e5: "Yet right after his return, another new crisis... The king has no time to catch his breath.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3505: "Yet right after his return, another new crisis... The king has no time to catch his breath.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|352d: "That you were invited, {var:1}, and that Princess Jade is safe is kept from the townsfolk.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3538: "Some still don't understand, but it's all to prevent panic among the people. Please understand.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3548: "Ugh... bleah... It's been so long since a banquet that I forgot my limit...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3557: "Ugh... bleah... I suddenly felt a chill and feel sick again...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3560: "If the king saw me like this, a pay cut wouldn't be the end of it... Ugh... bleah...

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43da: "Luminary, the king awaits. Please go to the throne room!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3577: "Oh, Luminary {var:1}. It's noisy upstairs. What happened this time...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35a1: "Welcome to Heliodor Castle! We've looked forward to the day we'd meet you again, Luminary!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35ac: "We're on watch so your visit doesn't cause a commotion. Please rest easy.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35bb: "The girl next to me is cute... Maybe I'll talk to her. But what if she has a boyfriend...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35cb: "I tried to run to the throne room to impress the cute blonde, but I'm frozen with fear...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35d7: "Ugh... Luminary, please see what's happening in the throne room...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35e6: "Salute to Heliodor's savior, Luminary {var:1}! Please, to the throne room!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|35f3: "A soldier on watch outside just burst in, pale. What happened...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3603: "Salute to the great Luminary {var:1}, who carries Erdwin's name! Please go through!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3635: "I take care of the wounded soldiers here.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|363d: "Different patients come every day, and beds are far too few... Where should I have them sleep next...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|364f: "If you're heading to battle, please don't get hurt, and return safely to the bastion.

tm.「あわ あわわ……。\n 先ほど 外の様子を 見てきたのですが……。\n 魔物た: "Eek! Eeek... I just went out to check outside... and the monsters have grown terribly violent.
tm.「目が 緑色の魔物には\n くれぐれも お気をつけください。\n ヤツら 以前の: "Be very careful of monsters with green eyes. They're many times stronger than before!
tm.「たくさんの兵士さんが 城に集まってるそうよ。\n ずいぶん いつもと雰囲気がち: "I hear lots of soldiers are gathering at the castle. The mood is so different. Is some event starting?
tm.「まあ 勇者さま。\n どこかへ 向かわれるのですか？\n 息つくヒマもなくて: "Oh, Luminary. Are you headed somewhere? You never get a moment to breathe.
tm.「それが 勇者という者の使命だとしたら\n 私なんかじゃ つとまりそうもないわ…: "If that's the Luminary's mission, I could never manage it...
tm.「大樹が 地に落ちる前は\n お日さまが ポカポカ当たるベンチで\n 恋人と一緒: "Before the great tree fell, I used to chat with my sweetheart on a sunny bench.
tm.「今となっては あの日々の すべてが\n 夢の中の出来事に思えるわ……。: "Now all those days seem like a dream...
tm.「コソコソ隠れていたって もうダメよ。\n 砦の中に 魔物が入ってきたら\n 私: "Hiding timidly is no use now. If monsters get into the bastion, we won't stand a chance...
tm.「ひとまず 魔物は退却したのよね……。\n よかった……よかったわ……。\n 私: "The monsters have retreated for now, right... Thank goodness... I was so scared...
tm.「勝利の夜だというのに\n なんだか 雨が降りそうだから\n 気持ちまで 暗くな: "It's a victory night, yet it looks like rain, and my spirits are dark too...
tm.「命の大樹が 地に落ちて 恋人を亡くした時。\n 今まで どうやって笑ってたのか: "When the great tree fell and I lost my sweetheart, I forgot how I used to laugh.
tm.「いつか 前みたいに\n 笑える日が 来るのかしら……。: "Will the day come when I can laugh like before...
tm.「ひさしぶりに見る お日さまの光は\n 本当に きれいね……。\n なんだか 泣: "The sunlight, seen for the first time in ages, is truly beautiful... It's making me cry.
tm.「デルカダール王が\n あなたを 待っていらっしゃるそうよ。\n 早く テントに: "The King of Heliodor is waiting for you. Hurry to his tent.
tm.「イシの村の人たちと ぬいものをしてたら\n すっかり 仲良くなっちゃったのよ。: "I sewed with the Cobblestone folk and we became good friends. I'm happy to have made new friends.
tm.「なんだか 町の中が 妙な雰囲気ねえ……。\n いつもより 兵士さんを よく見か: "The town feels strange. I see more soldiers than usual. What's about to start...?
tm.「なんだか イヤな予感がするわ……。\n お城に遊びにいった 城下町の人たちが\: "I have a bad feeling. The townsfolk who went to the castle haven't come back yet...
tm.「勇者の星が 落ちるなんて こわいわね……。\n 落ちた所が心配だわ。\n 今頃: "The Luminary's star falling is scary. I worry where it landed. What's happening there now?
tm.「今日は お城の方が にぎやかだな。\n 風に乗って うまそうなニオイがするけど: "The castle's lively today. A delicious smell drifts on the wind. Could they be holding a banquet...?
tm.「……って あの王さまに限って\n そんな 気前のいいこと するわけないか。\n: "...No, not that king. He'd never be so generous. Ah, I'm hungry.
tm.「まさか これまで お城を仕切っていたのが\n 魔物の……ニセモノの王さまだった: "The one who ran the castle until now was a monster... a fake king? I can hardly believe it...
tm.「知ってるだろうが この城下町の下には\n ならず者のふきだまりが あるんだ。\: "You probably know, but a haven for outlaws lies beneath this town. Best stay away.
tm.「グレイグ将軍と デルカダール王が\n ここを通って お城へ戻っていかれたんだ。: "General Hendrik and the King of Heliodor passed here back to the castle. Their sudden return made me nervous...
tm.「あの おふたりが 一緒に外出されるなんて\n めずらしい事も あるもんだな。\: "The two going out together is rare. Where on earth had they gone...?
tm.「勇者さまは 王より使命を言い渡されたはず。\n さあ 城門より\n デルカコス: "The Luminary has been given a mission by the king. Go through the castle gate to the Emerald Coast.
tm.「おいおい キミの彼氏は オレだぜ。\n チェッ まったく やんなっちゃうよな！: "Hey, your boyfriend's me, you know. Tch, I'm fed up!
tm.「けっ！ なーにが英雄殿だっ！\n ちょっとばかり 俺より背が高くて\n 俺より: "Bah! Some hero! He's just a bit taller, stronger, and better-looking than me!
tm.「オレは クチなら誰にも負けないが\n ホントのケンカは したことないんだ。\n: "I can out-talk anyone, but I've never had a real fight. Fighting monsters is no joke.
tm.「ダイアナちゃ～ん！\n オレも ウデをケガしちゃったぜ！\n 手当てしておくれ: "Roxy darling! I hurt my arm too! Treat me, please!
tm.「最後の砦にいるのは もうヤバいぜ！\n 早いとこ オレと一緒に\n 海の向こう: "The Last Bastion is too dangerous now! Let's quickly flee across the sea together!
tm.「へへへ。オレは アンタたちを信じてたから\n 最後の砦を見捨てて 逃げるなんて: "Heh heh. I believed in you, so I never considered abandoning the Last Bastion for even a second!
tm.「星が またたいて キレイだな～。\n こんな夜空を 女の子と見られれば\n サ: "The stars twinkle so prettily. It'd be perfect to watch a night sky like this with a girl.
tm.「オレは 恋に生きる男だからな。\n マルティナ姫のためなら\n 荷運びだって: "I'm a man who lives for love. For Princess Jade, I'll haul cargo or anything!
tm.「マルティナ姫をひと目見た その時から\n オレは 恋のトリコなのさ！\n あの: "From the moment I first saw Princess Jade, I've been love's captive! I love her sharp eyes!
tm.「なあ なあっ 聞いてくれよっ！\n さっき グレイグ将軍が ここを通ってさ！\: "Hey, hey, listen! General Hendrik just passed here! When I greeted him, he turned around!
tm.「一瞬だけ デルカダール王とも目が合ったし\n 今日のオレは 何かがツイてるぜ！: "I even locked eyes with the King of Heliodor for a moment. I'm lucky today! Ah, I should've asked for a handshake...!
tm.「食堂の前に立っている 青い髪の男……。\n どこかで 見たような気がするが\n: "The blue-haired man standing in front of the dining hall... I feel I've seen him somewhere. Where was it...?
tm.「くそっ……。こういう時に\n 情報屋のルパスがいれば どんなヤツの過去も\n: "Damn... At times like this, if Noah the informant were here, he'd know anyone's past instantly.
tm.「アンタと一緒にいる 青い髪の男……。\n どこかで 見たような気がするが\n: "The blue-haired man with you... I feel I've seen him somewhere. Where was it...?
tm.「なあ お兄さん！ 話は聞いたぜ！\n アンタ デルカダール王国を救った\n 勇: "Hey, mister! I heard! You're the Luminary who saved the Kingdom of Heliodor!
tm.「アンタのことは もう\n 国中で ウワサになってるぜ！: "Word of you has spread across the whole country!
tm.「ウチの子は 将来 兵士になりたいそうだけど\n 母親としては できれば\n あ: "My son wants to be a soldier someday, but as his mother I'd rather he didn't take such a dangerous job.
tm.「こんな ぶっそうな時代に 兵士になったら\n いつ 魔物に襲われて\n 命を落: "In these troubled times, a soldier could be attacked by monsters and die at any time...
tm.「あら あなた どうしたの？\n お城では 宴が開かれているそうだけど\n 抜け: "Oh, what's the matter? I hear a banquet's on at the castle. Did you slip out?
tm.「えっ……なぜ わかったのかって？\n だって あなたから ごちそうの\n いい: "What, how did I know? Because you smell of delicious feast food...
tm.「イヤだわ どうしましょう。\n 勇者の星が 落ちたって聞くけど\n デルカダー: "Oh dear, what will we do. They say the Luminary's star fell, but Heliodor is fine, right...?
tm.「そこで 道具屋をやっていた デクさんが\n 王国の外で 魔物に さらわれたんで: "Derk, who ran the item shop there, was carried off by a monster outside the kingdom. Poor wife...
tm.「道具屋の旦那さん 見つかったの！？\n ああ 無事で よかったわ……。: "Was the item shop husband found?! Ah, thank goodness he's safe...
tm.「気のいい人だったから\n 何か 不幸がなければ いいけどって\n ずっと 思っ: "He was such a kind man, I always hoped no misfortune would befall him.
tm.「なんだか 今日は 外がにぎやかだねえ。\n 平和がとりえの デルカダール王国に: "It's lively outside today. What could have happened in peaceful Heliodor...?
tm.「以前 城の宝物庫に盗みに入った ふとどき者が\n 地下牢から 脱走をはかりおっ: "Some scoundrel who once broke into the castle treasury tried to escape the dungeon. Our pay took a big hit...
tm.「くそっ……あの若造め！\n カオさえ はっきり覚えていれば\n 地獄まで追いか: "Damn that young punk! If only I clearly remembered his face, I'd chase him to hell and catch him!
tm.「おお……勇者 {var:1}さま。\n 勇者の星が落ちたことは 民にも伝わり\: "Oh... Luminary {var:1}. News of the Luminary's star falling has spread unease through the town.
tm.「お願いです {var:1}さま。\n 急ぎ デルカコスタ地方へ向かい\n 勇者: "Please, {var:1}. Hurry to the Emerald Coast and see how the Luminary's star looks.
tm.「オレ いつか グレイグ将軍みたいに\n 強くて やさしくて\n 兵士たちに ソ: "Someday I'll be strong and kind like General Hendrik, respected by soldiers!
tm.「お城の人たちは みーんな\n おいしいもの 食べてるんでしょ？\n ちぇっ ぼ: "Everyone at the castle is eating yummy food, right? Aw, I want to go too.
tm.「なんだか 外が静かだなあ……。\n 大人たちは みんな 酔っぱらって\n 寝ち: "It's quiet outside... Are the grown-ups all drunk and asleep...?
tm.「大人たち みんな ソワソワしてるけど\n 何があったか 誰も教えてくれないんだ: "The grown-ups are all fidgety but no one tells me why. Boring...
tm.「そこの男の子たちったら いつも\n つまらないことで はりあってばかりなの。\: "Those boys are always competing over silly things. So childish, it's annoying.
tm.「グレイグさまと ホメロスさまも\n 昔は あんなふうに\n ヤンチャだった頃が: "Maybe Hendrik and Jasper were that mischievous once too.
tm.「ねえねえ お兄ちゃん。\n あたしたちも 大人になったら\n 好きなだけ お城: "Hey, mister. When we grow up, we can play in the castle all we want, right?
tm.「ふああ……ねむいよう。\n もう そろそろ寝ないと\n ママに 怒られちゃうわ: "Yawn... I'm sleepy. If I don't sleep soon, Mama will scold me.
tm.「町の 大人たちだけじゃなくて\n 兵士さんまで 不安そうにしているの……。\n: "Not only the town adults but the soldiers too look anxious... I'm a little scared.
tm.「おいおい どうしたんだい\n 今日は なんだか 売れ行きが悪いようだね。: "Hey, what's up? Sales are slow today.
tm.「ふう お城の連中は うらやましいぜ。\n うまい料理を たらふく食えるんだもん: "Sigh, I envy the castle folks. They get to eat their fill of fine food.
tm.「オレも いつかは 城に招待されて\n たらふく ごちそうを食えるような\n そ: "Someday I want to be a man invited to the castle to feast.
tm.「闇と一緒に この大陸に やってきた魔物は\n なんだか オバケみたいなカッコウ: "The monsters that came with the darkness look like ghosts. Creepy bunch.
tm.「命の大樹が 地に落ちた日に\n 死んじまった人間や 動物の魂が\n 魔物に 変: "Rumor says the souls of people and animals who died the day the great tree fell were turned into monsters.
tm.「へへへ 聞いて おどろけ\n 俺は 飲めば 飲むほど強くなる！\n 酔拳の使い: "Heh heh, listen and be amazed! The more I drink, the stronger I get! I'm a drunken fist master! Hoyah!!
tm.「うぃ～ ヒック。\n 俺の酔拳の ただならぬ気配に おそれをなして\n 魔物は: "Hic. The monsters fled in terror from the awe of my drunken fist.
tm.聞いたことのない 大きなイビキだ。\n{var:1}は 耳をふさぎたくなった。:
An unbelievably loud snore.
{var:1} wanted to cover his ears.
tm.「今のデルカダール城は 宝の山 同然だ。\n お城は めちゃめちゃに 壊されて\: "Heliodor Castle is a treasure trove now. The castle's wrecked and no guards remain.
tm.「げへへ……王国の宝物庫ってのは\n どんな すごい お宝が置いてあるんだろうな: "Heh heh... I wonder what treasures sit in the kingdom's vault.
tm.「おっ 兄さん 旅の方かい？\n そりゃ いい時に来たもんだね。: "Oh, traveler? You came at a good time.
tm.「お城で めでたいことがあったらしくて\n もうすぐ 宴が開かれるそうだよ。\n: "Something happy happened at the castle, and a banquet's about to start. With luck you could get a feast.
tm.「お城で めでたいことがあって\n 宴が 開かれているそうだよ。\n うまくいけ: "Something happy happened at the castle, and a banquet is on. With luck you could get a feast.
tm.「おっ 兄さん 旅の方かい？\n そりゃまた ずいぶん\n 折の悪い時に やって: "Oh, traveler? You picked a bad time.
tm.「勇者さまを歓迎する宴は とっくに終わって\n 今は 勇者の星が落ちたとかで 大: "The banquet for the Luminary ended ages ago. Now it's an uproar over the Luminary's star falling.
tm.「おそろしいウワサを聞いたんだよ。\n なんでも デルカダール王は\n 魔物に: "I heard a terrible rumor. They say the King of Heliodor was possessed by a monster...
tm.「おっと ヤダよぉ お兄さん。\n 人の会話を 盗みぎきなんて お人が悪い。\n: "Oh no, mister. Eavesdropping on people is rude. Go away.
tm.「女だからって 隠れてるなんて\n あたしの 性に合わないからね。\n 武器を運: "Hiding just because I'm a woman doesn't suit me. Carrying weapons is nothing!
tm.「わかったら どいた どいた！\n 仕事のジャマだよ！: "Understand? Out of the way! You're in my way!
tm.「おー 忙しい 忙しい！\n ケガ人が 山ほど運ばれてくるから\n 休んでいるヒ: "Busy, busy! Piles of wounded keep coming, I've no time to rest!
tm.「ホメロスさまが お城を発たれてから\n ずいぶんになるけど どうされたのかしら: "It's been ages since Jasper left the castle. Where is he? I hope he isn't hurt somewhere.
tm.「王さまと グレイグ将軍は お戻りになったけど\n ホメロスさまのことは 何も言: "The king and General Hendrik returned, but say nothing about Jasper... It feels odd.
tm.「いつもなら この広場にいれば\n ゆっくり くつろげるのじゃが……。\n なに: "Usually I can relax in this plaza, but I have a bad feeling today.
tm.「はて……この 平和なデルカダール王国で\n 何が起ころうというんじゃろうな。: "What could happen in this peaceful Kingdom of Heliodor, I wonder.
tm.「グレイグ将軍が 勇者さまの仲間になられたか。\n 今まで敵対していた者同士は: "General Hendrik has joined the Luminary. Former enemies become reliable allies once they share a goal.
tm.「グレイグ将軍と 勇者さまのふたりが\n チカラを合わせれば 鬼に金棒じゃのう。: "With the general and the Luminary joining forces, they're unbeatable. I pray for a safe journey.
tm.「そ…その サラサラヘアは！\n もしや カミュのアニキの連れの人！？: "T-that silky hair! Are you Erik's friend?!
tm.「ワタシのこと 覚えてるかなー？\n カミュのアニキの 弟分のデクだよー！: "Do you remember me? I'm Derk, Erik's little brother figure!
tm.「それにしたって おどろいたよー！\n あの後 風のウワサで聞いたんだけど\n: "Still, I was shocked! I heard through the grapevine afterward that you were the legendary Luminary!
tm.「勇者を 旅の連れにするなんて\n さすがは カミュのアニキだよー！\n 男の器: "Having the Luminary as a travel companion is just like Erik! His capacity is something else!
tm.「そう……。お兄さんにも わからないんだね。\n あの混乱の中じゃ 仕方がないよ: "I see... you don't know either. Can't be helped in that chaos.
tm.「……ウソを言わなくても イイのよー。\n 一緒に いないってことは\n アニキ: "...You needn't lie. If he's not with you, something must have happened to him...
tm.「でも 大丈夫！ カミュのアニキは\n これで へこたれるほど ヤワじゃないよー: "But it's fine! Erik isn't weak enough to be beaten by this. I believe in him.
tm.「お兄さんこそ ひとり旅はタイヘンでしょー？\n ワタシの店で 必要なモノを買っ: "You must find traveling alone hard. Buy what you need at my shop. Well then...
tm.「いやぁー。タイヘンなことになってるねー！\n お兄さんも 戦いの前に ワタシの: "Wow, what a mess! Prepare at my shop before the fight! Well then...
tm.「いやぁー。お疲れさまだよー！\n 勝利の記念に 買い物してってよー！\n それ: "Phew, good work! Shop to celebrate the victory! Well then...
tm.「お兄さん 常闇を生む魔物を 倒しにいくなら\n ワタシの店で キチンと準備しな: "If you're going to defeat the monster that makes the everlasting dark, prepare properly at my shop. Well then...
tm.「お兄さん 冒険の旅の途中で\n カミュのアニキに 会うことが あったら\n ワ: "If you meet Erik on your adventure, tell him I'm doing well!
tm.「ハっ！ その青い髪 キリっとした目元……\n アニキー！ アニキー！ カミュの: "Hah! That blue hair, those sharp eyes... Erik! Erik! You're alive and well!
tm.「ワタシ アニキに会える日を 信じて\n 女房とふたり 必死に がんばったんだよ: "I worked hard with my wife, believing the day I'd see you again would come! I'm so happy to see you!
tm.「……って いけない いけない。\n 積もる話もあるけれど カミュのアニキと\n: "...Oops. Much to talk about, but you and the Luminary are still on your journey, right?
tm.「あんまり 引きとめるのは よくないよね。\n 世界を救う旅が 終わったら\n: "Better not hold you up. When the journey to save the world is over, tell me everything!
tm.「旅のそなえに 必要なものがあれば\n ワタシの店で 買い物していきなよー！\n: "If you need anything for your journey, shop at my store! Well then...
tm.「やーやー！ 勇者さんに カミュのアニキー！\n よく 来てくれたねー！\n ワ: "Hey hey! Luminary and Erik! Thanks for coming! Shop leisurely at my store!
tm.「わーい カミュのアニキ 無事だったんだね！\n どうしているか 心配だったけど: "Yay, Erik is safe! I was worried about how you were, but I'm so glad to see you again!
tm.「カミュのアニキ もしかして これから\n デルカダール城に 行くつもりなのかな: "Erik, are you perhaps going to Heliodor Castle? Be careful not to get caught again!
tm.「わーい カミュのアニキー！\n 勇者さまと アニキに また会えて\n ホントに: "Yay, Erik! I'm so, so happy to see you and the Luminary again!
